body.content: Hypothesis: The optimal configuration for 13 points might be related to the 'no-three-in-line' problem on a discrete grid, but scaled and perturbed. If we place points on a 5x5 grid (25 points) and select 13 such that no three are collinear, then perturb them off the grid to maximize area, we might find a strong candidate.
body.possible_next_move: Search for known solutions to the no-three-in-line problem for n=13 on a 5x5 grid and test their minimum triangle areas when inscribed in the unit square.
